changeSet.author: mirror
changeSet.comment: Set is_serialized = true for existing jewelry products based on category prefix
changeSet.sql: UPDATE mirror_products SET is_serialized = true WHERE category IN ('RNG', 'NEC', 'BRC', 'EAR', 'PND', 'SET', 'CHN', 'BNG', 'ANK', 'BRO', 'CUF', 'TIE', 'WTH', 'CLP') OR category LIKE 'RNG%' OR category LIKE 'NEC%' OR category LIKE 'BRC%' OR category LIKE 'EAR%' OR category LIKE 'PND%' OR category LIKE 'SET%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'RNG-%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'NEC-%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'BRC-%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'EAR-%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'PND-%' OR mirror_code LIKE 'SET-%';

changeSet.author: mirror
changeSet.comment: Create one product_unit for each existing jewelry product with a barcode
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO product_units (id, product_id, unit_barcode, status, location, cost_price, sale_price, purchase_date, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT('UNIT', LPAD(nextval('product_unit_seq')::text, 6, '0')), mp.id, mp.barcode, 'AVAILABLE', mp.location, mp.cost, mp.price, mp.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM mirror_products mp WHERE mp.is_serialized = true AND mp.barcode IS NOT NULL AND mp.barcode != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_units pu WHERE pu.product_id = mp.id );

changeSet.author: mirror
changeSet.comment: Clear product-level barcode for serialized jewelry (each unit has its own barcode)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE mirror_products SET barcode = NULL WHERE is_serialized = true AND id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM product_units);
